text: Manohar moves his large family into [apartment 13B, on the thirteenth floor of a new building|trigger|making a new home]. Milk curdles every day, the lift works for everyone but him, and his face comes out blurred and twisted in his phone's photos. At one o'clock each afternoon, [a serial on channel 13|images|pictures, screens and recordings] shows a family just like his, and what happens on screen soon happens to them, though [only Manu sees the pattern|rules|only some can see it]. A dog's digging leads him to an old photo album and [a family of eight murdered in 1977|wrong|a life taken] on this very ground.
